verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no Reflect-native way for users to define their own automations, such as scheduled or triggered AI agents or rules. The AI palette and custom prompts are invoked manually. Kindle sync, background audio transcription and auto-created daily notes are fixed built-in behaviors rather than automations a user sets up, which makes them adjacent features. Automation through Zapier or the REST API relies on an external tool or developer building blocks, so it earns no credit.
